admin0RelationOverride.reason: Owner decision 2026-10-13: non-sovereign territories and disputed places are in scope. Western Sahara (EH) is a territory, not a sovereign state (a disputed Non-Self-Governing Territory). In OpenStreetMap the only relation carrying ISO3166-1=EH is relation 2559126 (no admin_level tag); it is boundary=administrative with no admin_level tag, so the default admin-0 rule (boundary=administrative, admin_level=2) finds none. Game venue map only: no claims about real operations, borders or sovereignty; OSM mapped boundary, not legal-border authority. Every other proof (member ways, area assembly, segment match) still applies.
